title: Regularity, dimension, residue and function field of the smooth strict localization
statement: Let $K$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and let $Y$ be a smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] finite-type $K$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] of Krull dimension $d$ [def-kun-dimension]. For a geometric point $\bar y$ [def-weil-geometric-point] with image $y$, put $a=\operatorname{trdeg}_K\kappa(y)$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree], using the residue field [def-weil-residue-field] and $R=\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y,\bar y}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Then $R$ is a regular local integral domain [def-weil-regular-scheme] of dimension $d-a$, its residue field is the chosen separable closure of $\kappa(y)$, and its fraction field is an algebraic extension of $K(Y)$ (the fraction field of the coordinate ring of any nonempty affine open of $Y$) via the structural embedding.

proof.text: The equation hOmega identifies the given residue-field embedding into Omega with descResidueField(stalkClosedPointTo s): cancel the monomorphism fromSpecResidueField and use full faithfulness of Spec. Apply strictHenselizationResidue, clause (1) of the functoriality node, for the local structure and the specified residue equivalence. Its pointed structural factorization is exactly the residue equation in the conclusion.

proof.text: Choose an affine open U containing y, with ring A, and lift s to xR through its open immersion. The lift prime is the chart prime of y by injectivity of the immersion on points. Apply etale_local_ring_triples, using the compatibility module Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleLocalRingTriples. Use the canonical colimit cocone of strictHenselizationAffineDiagram (the diagram defining strictHenselizationRing), not smallStrictHenselizationCocone, whose vertex is the older upstream construction. Finality of the representative affine inclusion compares this colimit with the affine-neighbourhood colimit; compose with the triples comparison. Check the structural map on the triple (A,p,l) by the comparison leg equations and strictHenselizationStructuralMap_eq. The localized-triples theorem equips this same ring with its strict-henselization algebra over B=A_p, preserving its A-map b. All this is the proved private helper smooth_chart_local_presentation.

proof.text: Smooth.isRegularLocalRing_stalk in the proved source-library module WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Smooth makes the stalk at y regular. Transport this across the localization equivalence B = O_(Y,y). Strict henselization preserves regularity. The proved regular-local-domain instance gives IsDomain R.

proof.text: The source-library theorem topologicalKrullDim_opens_eq makes every open neighbourhood of y have dimension d. Apply topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_of_forall to conclude dim_y Y=d. Full faithfulness of Spec and hKappa identify the given K-algebra on kappa(y) with f.residueFieldAlgebraMap y. The finite-type dimension formula and ha give d=dim O_(Y,y)+a. Regularity expresses dim O_(Y,y) as the natural spanFinrank of its maximal ideal; cancellation in Nat gives dim O_(Y,y)=d-a. Transport across the affine stalk-localization equivalence and strict-henselization dimension equality.

proof.text: Apply the affine-chart ind-etale theorem to the structural A-map b of the chart presentation. The proved source-library ind-etale-to-weakly-etale instance (Algebra.IndEtale.weaklyEtale in WeilConjectures.RingTheory.ProEtale.IndWeaklyEtale) makes the ring flat over A. Since A is a domain and the strict localization is nonzero, flatness implies torsion freeness and faithfulness: multiplication by each nonzero a in A is injective, by tensoring its injective multiplication map on A. Thus b is injective. The injection into Q=Frac(R) extends by IsFractionRing.lift to i:Y.functionField -> Q, since functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen identifies Y.functionField as the fraction field of A. The lift equation on A, together with IsAffineOpen.fromSpecStalk_eq_fromSpecStalk and the structural equation of b, proves the required equality of scheme morphisms.

source.place: Proof, Local calculation in dimension d, second paragraph: regularity, dimension, residue and algebraic fraction field

proof.text: The affine-chart theorem gives Algebra.IndEtale A R for the structural b. Give Q the Y.functionField-algebra induced by i; the lift equation supplies the compatible A-scalar tower. Apply the already proved source-library theorem Algebra.IndEtale.isSeparable_of_algHom_to_isLocalRing (WeilConjectures.RingTheory.ProEtale.IndEtale) to R -> Q, with fraction field Y.functionField of A. Every image of r in R is separable, hence integral, over Y.functionField. Express each element of Q as a quotient of images of elements of R by IsFractionRing.div_surjective. Integral elements over a field are closed under products and inverses, hence each quotient is algebraic. This proves the conclusion with exactly the algebra structure induced by i.

theorem smooth_strict_local_field_model_core
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [Smooth f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (d a : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Y = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y)
    (y : Y) (hy : s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = y)
    [Algebra K (Y.residueField y)]
    (hκ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (Y.residueField y))) =
      Y.fromSpecResidueField y ≫ f)
    [Algebra (Y.residueField y) Ω]
    (hΩ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.residueField y) Ω)) ≫
      Y.fromSpecResidueField y = s)
    (ha : Algebra.trdeg K (Y.residueField y) = (a : Cardinal))
    [Algebra K (strictHenselizationRing s)]
    (hK : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (strictHenselizationRing s))) =
      strictHenselizationStructuralMap s ≫ f) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (strictHenselizationRing s) ∧
    ∃ hlocal : IsLocalRing (strictHenselizationRing s),
      ∃ hdomain : IsDomain (strictHenselizationRing s),
        letI := hlocal
        letI := hdomain
        ringKrullDim (strictHenselizationRing s) = ((d - a : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        ∃ e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField (strictHenselizationRing s) ≃+*
            separableClosure (Y.residueField y) Ω,
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            ((separableClosure (Y.residueField y) Ω).subtype.comp
              (e.toRingHom.comp (IsLocalRing.residue (strictHenselizationRing s))))) ≫
            strictHenselizationStructuralMap s = s ∧
          ∃ i : Y.functionField →+* FractionRing (strictHenselizationRing s),
            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom i) ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y) =
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (algebraMap (strictHenselizationRing s)
                  (FractionRing (strictHenselizationRing s)))) ≫
                strictHenselizationStructuralMap s ∧
            (letI := i.toAlgebra
             Algebra.IsAlgebraic Y.functionField (FractionRing (strictHenselizationRing s)))
